name: Slake That Thirst

meta.next: Another Power Source?, Tanaris Field Sampling

summary: In Gadgetzan, Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle needs five Wastewander Water Pouches before he can supply the 4711-FTZ power source for your kit. The Wastewander nomads east of town carry them.

sections.title: A Drink for a Power Source
sections.body: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan can help with the power source your kit needs after Into the Field. First, he asks you for five Wastewander Water Pouches. The Wastewander nomads live east of Gadgetzan, and Bilgewhizzle suggests you walk up and ask one for water. He wants to hear how it goes.

sections.title: A Limit on the Power
sections.body: The 4711-FTZ power source was not made for a science kit. Once you hand over the pouches, you can use it, but your gathered data lasts two hours at most. Bring the source back to Bilgewhizzle when you have what you need, so he can shut it down properly. If time runs out, you can get another source, but you will have to buy it.

faq.q: Who asks for the water pouches?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan asks for five Wastewander Water Pouches in return for the 4711-FTZ power source.

faq.q: Where do you find the Wastewander Water Pouches?
faq.answer: You can get Wastewander Water Pouches from the Wastewander nomads east of Gadgetzan.

faq.q: What power source does Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle offer?
faq.answer: Bilgewhizzle offers the 4711-FTZ power source for your kit.
